description: Move one work order exactly one step: draft, scheduled, in_progress, done, invoiced, stamping date and note. A skipped, backwards or backdated step is refused and nothing is written. Free.

date.description: The day it reached this status, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

note.description: What happened, e.g. Booked for Tuesday morning, or Signed off by the tenant

status.description: The status to move to. It must be the next one along

work_order.description: The work order id, e.g. WO-2026-0001, or the client name when only one job is theirs

name: work_order_status
title: Move a work order along
